Nadia (Marketing): Final check for tomorrow's announcementWe need: canonical changelog link, docs shortlink, exact canary start, webinar CTA + reg link, and lead routing rule. Can engineering lock the timing and fallback behavior?
Sam (Engineering): Changelog is merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/533. It lists model-pinning, batching defaults, and the new SDK opt-in flag.
Sam (Engineering): Rollout plan: start canary 08:30 PT -> 45m watch -> gradual ramp to 50% by 11:00 PT -> full by 15:30 PT. Auto-fallback to last-stable model if error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m.
Nadia (Marketing): Please lock the canary start for the countdown timer and embargo schedule.
Sam (Engineering): Locked. Feature flag: rf_march24_launch=true at 08:30 PT. Health gates: p95 < 440ms and error_rate < 1% (5m window).
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled for 2026-03-24T15:30:00Z (08:30 PT). Monitors: latency_p95, error_rate, kv_cache_hit_ratio.
Eli (Docs): Docs live at https://docs.redwood.com/releases/mar-24-launch. Shortlink for marketing: https://rwd.io/mar24-launch. Added anchors: #model-pinning and #batching.
Ruth (Product): Suggested messaging: predictable inference via model pinning; lower unit costs with smarter batching; safe rollouts with canary + auto-fallback. Add a short benchmark line linking to our bench post.
Nadia (Marketing): Webinar is set for 10:15 PT 15m demo + 15m live Q&A. Registration: https://events.redwood.com/mar24.
Nadia (Marketing): Lead routing: can ops route webinar signups and launch-page leads to SDR queue 'launch-mar24' and tag by region + product interest?
ops-oncall: Will create HubSpot rule: source=mar24_launch -> queue=launch-mar24; tags: region from form + interest. Will test in staging and promote at 07:45 PT. Will monitor lead spikes for first 48h.
Sam (Engineering): Note: small embeddings config tweak at 11:05 PT (30s). Demo should avoid embedding-heavy calls at that time.
Nadia (Marketing): Noted. We'll adjust demo script.
Eli (Docs): FAQ snippet for marketing: "How to pin a model: see Model pinning section with CLI and SDK examples."
Ruth (Product): Checklist: changelog link 705, docs shortlink 705, canary + rollback 705, webinar + deck (marketing to share by 07:00 PT), lead routing 705.
ops-oncall: Routing rule created and validated in staging; will promote and confirm here at 07:46 PT. Dashboard shared to #launch-ops.
Nadia (Marketing): Embargo plan: public post at 10:00 PT (30m before webinar) — we'll only publish if canary is green. Please keep #release-monitor open. :rocket:
Sam (Engineering): Agreed. If any health gate trips, we'll roll back and post in #release-monitor.
Nadia (Marketing): Thanks all. If anything urgent ping me directly.
